anomalies.description: A second man forcefully shoves a cloth into the mouth of the first man, who appears restrained and unable to resist; the action is sustained and deliberate, consistent with gagging or smothering.

A man in the passenger seat is forcibly holding a cloth or tissue over the mouth and nose of the driver, who appears restrained and struggling; this constitutes suffocation attempt or smothering, a form of physical abuse.
